listing.name: SkillPilot
listing.tagline: Personal learning paths and progress with Claude
listing.description: SkillPilot lets Claude work with your personal learning path without receiving your permanent SkillPilot ID. Claude can load your curriculum and current goal, suggest next steps, coach you through exercises, and record completed goals. Dedicated components can display an approved learning-goal image and run private normal flashcard practice; strict Verified Recall and exam workflows remain separate. Connect SkillPilot once from Claude's Connectors Directory through OAuth, then start every learning session at https://skillpilot.com/. SkillPilot creates an opaque session beginning with spc_ that is valid for exactly 24 hours; the permanent ID remains inside SkillPilot. Connector OAuth may keep the technical connection active but neither contains nor selects learner identity. SkillPilot receives only the connector requests needed for these actions, not your entire Claude chat or Claude memory. Corrections or withdrawals of completion for ordinary goals remain available in the SkillPilot Cockpit. Claude is instructed to wait for your complete answer before requesting protected answers or evaluation. For adults aged 18 or older.

useCases.title: Choose the next learning goal
useCases.description: Load the learner's current focus, prerequisites and available learning goals, then explain and choose a sensible next goal.
useCases.examplePrompt: Use SkillPilot to load my current learning context and help me choose the next sensible learning goal.

useCases.title: Learn and record verified progress
useCases.description: Claude coaches the active goal and is instructed to record it as completed only after checking suitable work. Completion is not a grade. Correct or withdraw it later in the SkillPilot Cockpit.
useCases.examplePrompt: Help me work on my active SkillPilot goal. Check my understanding before recording any progress.

useCases.title: Run guided recall and exam workflows
useCases.description: Claude presents the complete SkillPilot recall batch or exam task and is instructed to wait for the learner's complete response before requesting protected answers or evaluation.
useCases.examplePrompt: Start verified recall for my active SkillPilot memory goal and wait for all my answers before grading.

prerequisites: A Claude account that can use connectors
A fresh learning session started at https://skillpilot.com/
